players.product: AI data-center campus leases on converted Bitcoin-mining power sites (Sandersville GA 175 MW critical IT on a 20-year triple net lease, tenant undisclosed; Sealy and Brazoria TX under exclusivity)

quarterly_data.signal: CleanSpark's 8-K: the Sandersville, Georgia lease was entered on July 10, 2026 with a leading global technology company with a high investment grade credit profile (unnamed); it is a triple net lease with annual escalators covering data center infrastructure supporting 175 megawatts of critical IT load, deliveries expected to begin in Q4 2027. The lease requires CleanSpark to satisfy specified financing, construction and delivery milestones; failure to meet them may result in rent abatements or termination. The tenant's letter of intent and exclusivity covers the Texas portfolio of 718 acres: 271 acres with nearly 300 MW at the Sealy campus and 447 acres at the Brazoria campus, where transmission-level infrastructure supports an initial 300 MW demand load with the potential to expand to 600 MW.
quarterly_data.figure: Sealy 271 acres, nearly 300 MW; Brazoria 447 acres, initial 300 MW expandable to 600 MW
